result.title: Learning to Be Truncated: Preparing LLM Checkpoints for SVD Compression
result.summary: Compression based on singular value decomposition (SVD) often requires subsequent fine-tuning or weight correction to mitigate performance degradation. Budget-specific optimization must be repeated for different compression ratios. We introduce LLift, which prepares a pretrained model for SVD compression across ratios without further fine-tuning. LLift fine-tunes a low-rank approximation at a single ratio using the original model as a teacher. We merge the learned updates into the original weights while preserving the complementary components excluded from the training forward pass. We apply SVD to the prepared model's target matrices and reuse the decompositions at different truncation ranks. On LLaMA-7B, we demonstrate accuracy gains across three compression ratios using a single prepared model. The gains extend across model families, model sizes, and SVD compression operators. We analyze gradients and an early training update to provide local evidence that updates learned at one ratio can benefit compression at other ratios. These results show that LLift can improve compression across deployment budgets without fine-tuning each compressed model separately.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 LLift：以原模型为教师，在单一压缩比下微调低秩近似，再把更新合并回原权重并保留训练中被排除的互补分量，随后对目标矩阵做 SVD 并在不同截断秩复用同一分解，从而让一个 checkpoint 服务多种压缩预算而无需逐比例微调。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理无直接关联，但「单一预算训练、跨秩复用分解」及保留互补分量的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态在低秩瓶颈下的信息保留与多计算预算共享工作区的训练方式提供核查线索。
